title: Goodwill Schedule for Late Refund Postings to Harborline Account Credit
content:
# Goodwill schedule for late refund postings

Harborline's published goodwill schedule for late refund postings credits goodwill to the account, without the customer having to ask, for the customer's most recent domain refund line returned to account credit, when the account's refund credit entry for the refunded charge's order number was posted late after the refund line.

## Grant conditions

1. Goodwill credit may be granted only while the account status is active.
2. One grant may be made per affected holding or charge reference.
3. The grant is posted against the reference of that refund line, with domain as the affected category.
4. Where the amount the schedule yields is zero, nothing is owed and no entry is posted.

## Recording the grant

The goodwill is recorded with the agent-side tool `grant_refund_posting_goodwill_cac8bb9c`. Unlock it first and then call it; it is run by the agent, not handed to the customer. One call records one goodwill credit on the customer's Harborline account credit, posted against the reference of the domain refund line with domain as the affected product: the account credit balance goes up by the goodwill amount and the goodwill appears on the account's credit history at once, spendable on any Harborline product and never withdrawable.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `account_id` | The reference number of the customer's Harborline account, as shown on the account record opened for this customer. | Identifier, as shown on the record |
| `source_charge_ref` | The reference of the domain refund line, character for character, as shown on the domain billing history. | Reference exactly as shown on the record; the empty string is not used |
| `amount` | The goodwill credited, in US dollars. | A positive figure with 2 decimal places; any further decimals are rounded half up to the cent |

## What the call returns

A completed call returns a confirmation line beginning "Goodwill credited", stating the reference number of the new goodwill entry, the amount credited in US dollars with two decimals, the reference it was posted against and the account's new credit balance in US dollars with two decimals.

The call is refused with an error line when `amount` is not a positive US dollar figure, or when `source_charge_ref` is not the refund line reference unchanged (empty, padded with spaces or containing a space).

*Applies to: Harborline Customer Accounts*
